sql: SELECT p.market_title, p.period_reward_usd pool, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.close_time, p.target_size tgt, p.discount_factor_bps disc, s.at snap_at, s.best_yes_bid by, s.best_no_bid bn, s.yes_levels_json ylv, s.est_yes_score_total fy, s.est_no_score_total fn, s.est_yes_meets_target ym, s.est_no_meets_target nm, (SELECT string_agg(status||' '||limit_price||'x'||quantity, ', ') FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' AND o.market_ticker='KXFEAR-26OCT09-GREE') orders FROM incentive_programs p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM incentive_market_snapshots s WHERE s.market_ticker=p.market_ticker ORDER BY s.at DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true WHERE p.market_ticker='KXFEAR-26OCT09-GREE' ORDER BY p.last_seen_at DESC LIMIT 1
